description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically for configuring in-memory streaming capabilities with optional custom serializers.

classes.name: SiloBuilderMemoryStreamExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring in-memory streams on ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use memory streams with the default message serializer.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams<TSerializer>
methods.description: Configures the silo to use memory streams with a specified serializer type.
